description: This Java class 'ValidateMethod' defines a string operation that dynamically calls a validation method via reflection, used within the OFBiz minilang framework.

classes.name: ValidateMethod
classes.description: A class that performs validation by invoking specified methods via reflection, based on XML element attributes.

methods.name: ValidateMethod
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validation class and method names from XML attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the validation by converting input, loading the class, invoking the method, and handling validation result.
